svg.title: Two Riemann spheres joined by an arrow f: on the left, the lower hemisphere D (the unit disk) is shaded, with infinity at the top, 0 at the bottom and -i, 1, i, -1 on the equator; on the right, the image sphere has -1 sent to infinity at the top, 1 sent to 0 at the bottom, i sent to 1 on the front meridian, 0 sent to i on the right, and the shaded right hemisphere is the upper half plane H.
